title: Thursday, 6:45 a.m.
intro: Everything is the wrong height. Also, you have homework.

items.label: Red ribbon on the doorknob
items.text: A red ribbon on the doorknob. You look at it for a while. 'FACT,' you think. 'Somebody comes in my room.'

items.label: Mirror
items.text: A very short person with extraordinary hair. Your fingertips are pruned. 'From the bath,' you decide, firmly.

items.label: Sir Hours (tortoise)
items.text: Sir Hours turns at tortoise speed to face the window. Then, very slowly, he lifts one front foot and waves at the lake.

items.label: Index cards: FACTS ABOUT GROWN-UPS
items.text: A rubber-banded stack. FACT 12: grown-ups say 'it's fine' when it isn't. FACT 31: Auntie Nell never gets wet when it rains. Underlined three times.

items.label: The practice lamp
items.text: The lantern-bearer's lamp, a small brass one with a cracked pane, in the closet. Today at four there is lamp practice. Your stomach does something complicated.

items.label: Drawing: Wren and me
items.text: Two figures holding hands. One is you. The other is blue, drawn in wet-looking crayon, and labelled W. The lake is behind them. It is drawn very big.

items.label: The window
items.text: You can see the lake from here. You wave. The ripples come back in step. You don't tell anyone anymore. You told once.

items.label: Tin of baby teeth
items.text: Eleven teeth. One of them has a note: 'Dr. Pell: paid in stickers.'

items.label: School bag
items.text: A form: LAMP-BEARER, PLEASE RETURN SIGNED. A sticker of a very angry dinosaur has been placed over the word SIGNED.

items.label: Paper-towel periscope
items.text: Engineered for seeing over the sofa. Possibly for seeing over grown-ups.

items.label: Dinosaur Facts, Vol. 3
items.text: The Stegosaurus had a brain the size of a lime. You think about that for longer than is healthy.

items.label: Unmade bed
items.text: Pillow fort, two torches, one lonely sock. A sense of unfinished business.
